NBA DFS Picks for Tuesday, November 17 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, November 17 · 5 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 17, 12:31 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Tuesday, November 17 DraftKings main slate at 63.4 DraftKings points for $12,200. Victor Wembanyama (SAS, 57.7, $11,700) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 48.1, $10,000) are next.

Terrence Shannon Jr. (MIN) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.32 projected points per $1,000 at $4,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 17, 12:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
